parse_dotenv_string: parse a DOTENV-format string into a dictionary of key-value pairs
handle_quoted_dotenv_values: handle single-quoted and double-quoted values in a DOTENV string with escape sequences
skip_comments_and_blank_lines: skip comment lines starting with # and blank lines while parsing a DOTENV string
resolve_export_keyword: strip the optional export keyword from DOTENV key-value pairs during parsing
fallback_to_environ: fallback to current environment variables when a DOTENV key has no assigned value
